worktree: local-operator-ui/.worktrees/i18n-composer-keying (ur catalogues uncommitted on disk at audit time)

scope_method.how_computed: not assumed: for each of the 21 composer namespaces, sha256(src/i18n/catalogues/ur/<ns>.json) was compared with the target hash the latest receipt covering that namespace recorded. For all 21 the latest is 3e9c47b1-s3c-ur — namespace-block sha256.ur for its 13 blocks, carried_namespaces[].matching_sha256 for its 8 carried rows — so no older s3a/s3b hash was used as a baseline where s3c already covered the namespace.

auditor.actual_model_source: session header anthropic/claude-sonnet-5-5; provider quota (HTTP 429) forced fallbacks anthropic/claude-opus-5-5 -> openai/gpt-6.1-sol -> deepseek/deepseek-flash before the first tool call, and the session stayed on deepseek/deepseek-flash for the whole audit; every byte read, parse, render and gate result in this receipt was produced under that model

method.icu: all 50 audited ur values and their 50 English sources parsed with @formatjs/icu-messageformat-parser (requiresOtherClause). Argument names, argument order, number styles, plural/select option sets and `#` usage compared per key: 0 differences. Urdu plural categories are one/other only, as CLDR requires, on all 4 plural messages (ask_panel.landing.many, ask_panel.lapse.many, composer_notes.goal.stalled.cap, composer_notes.outside_mentions); every plural has `other` and uses `#` where the source does. Measured with Intl.PluralRules('ur') in the worktree's Node 24.22.1: pluralCategories one/other, select(0)=other, select(1)=one, select(2|5|11|21|100)=other — the four plural messages carry exactly one/other and `#` renders where the source uses it, so their branch sets are the correct CLDR set, not an English one/other copy that happens to parse.
method.render: intl-messageformat locale ur for the 4 plural messages at counts 0,1,2,5,11,21,100 with realistic arguments, plus every changed key and every key carrying a placeholder at realistic values (max=2000/9/4, count=1234, model=anthropic/claude-opus-5-5, device=Damian's iPhone, name=pergamon-dev-worker/i18n, command=model, reason=the localized fallback). Output judged as an Urdu reader, not only for placeholder survival.
method.hygiene: NFC, no edge space, no double space, no non-ASCII whitespace anywhere (ASCII spaces inside every ICU argument header), no manual bidi controls, no Devanagari/danda, no Arabic-only yeh/kaf/teh-marbuta, Urdu ۔ ، ؛ ؟ punctuation only, ellipsis U+2026 and em dash U+2014 preserved where the English has them, backticks around {name} and the / in /{command} byte-identical
method.rtl: every changed string rendered with fribidi --rtl --nopad --nobreak --clean. dock.keys_range now paints as '9 ﺎﺗ 1' (reading right-to-left: 1, تا, 9 — logical range preserved, the defect UR-C1 described); the / in /{command} and the Latin values {model}/{device} were NOT judged on the un-isolated fribidi run because head 7540e3cbc9d applies isolateSigils (LRI/PDI) and isolateArguments (FSI/PDI) at render time for RTL-answered messages only — judged by reading src/i18n/bidi.ts, not by assuming it
method.glossary: each term grepped across the 8093 shipped ur values that lie outside these 21 composer namespaces (the same baseline scripts/i18n/ur-activation.test.mjs reports), so the precedent counts never include this PR's own uncommitted files: default=ڈیفالٹ 81 values, session=سیشن 253, sessions plural=سیشنز 32, device=ڈیوائس 71, agent=ایجنٹ 598, model=ماڈل 183, skill=مہارت 84, provider=فراہم کنندہ 86, backend=بیک اینڈ 65, judge=جج 2, goal=ہدف 45, pending=منتظر 40, settled=طے شدہ 3, clear=صاف ہو 10, mark-read=نشان زد 18 vs نشان لگ 4. Every audited term matches the dominant shipped form; the one split (mark-read) is named as UR-D2, and the composers' own «خودکار … جاری رکھنا/رکھنے» family has no shipped precedent outside this PR, so it was judged on idiom rather than by grep.
method.stubs: one value is identical to English — ui.chat.ask_panel.filter.chip '{label} · {count, number}' — and it is the placeholder-only global row this PR added to IDENTICAL_OK in scripts/i18n/locale-parity.test.mjs (language-neutral composition, no words). No other value is a copy of the English.
method.gates: read-only: node --test scripts/i18n/locale-parity.test.mjs 44/44 pass; node scripts/i18n/context-parity.mjs ok (131 allowed gaps in 4 namespaces); node --test scripts/i18n/ur-activation.test.mjs 3/3 pass over 8093 bundled ur values. generate.mjs --check not run (stale until the manager regenerates), per the brief.
method.numbering: ur renders Latin digits with comma grouping at these counts: new Intl.NumberFormat('ur').format(2000) = '2,000' and .format(1234) = '1,234', matching glossary §3 (zh-CN/ur '1,234.5') and the style guide's 'Latin digits in v1'. The other_mentions/landing/lapse/cap renders above show the count in the sentence where the English puts it.

findings.current: ہدف رک گیا: خودکار طور پر جاری رکھنا رک گیا — آگے بڑھانے کے لیے پیغام بھیجیں
findings.proposed: ہدف رک گیا: خودکار جاری رکھنا بند ہو گیا — آگے بڑھانے کے لیے پیغام بھیجیں
findings.reason: The sibling note UR-C3 fixed (goal.stalled.cap) repeated its head verb in one clause; this note still does the same, reading «ہدف رک گیا: … جاری رکھنا رک گیا» with «رک گیا» twice in six words. «بند ہو گیا» carries 'stopped' and drops the echo. NIT: the meaning is unambiguous today and nothing renders wrong.

findings.current: ہدف رک گیا: {count, plural, one {# بار} other {# بار}} خودکار جاری رکھنے کے بعد — آگے بڑھانے کے لیے پیغام بھیجیں
findings.reason: Applied UR-C3 drops «طور پر» (kept in agent.stalled.cap_fallback and agent.stalled.unknown: «خودکار طور پر جاری رکھنے…»). Judged acceptable, not a finding: as an attributive before the verbal noun «خودکار جاری رکھنے» is idiomatic Urdu, and re-inserting the adverbial would lengthen the only note that carries a count in the middle of the clause. Recorded so the family reads the same on the next touch.

findings.current: پڑھا ہوا نشان لگ رہا ہے
findings.proposed: اس چیٹ پر پڑھا ہوا نشان لگ رہا ہے۔
findings.reason: Same English verb 'mark (read)' now maps to two local forms inside one namespace: the applied UR-C2 clause uses «نشان لگانا» («پڑھا ہوا نشان لگ رہا ہے») while description.pending keeps the dominant «نشان زد کرنا» («اس چیٹ کو پڑھا ہوا نشان زد کیا جا رہا ہے۔»). Shipped ur precedent, excluding this PR's 21 namespaces: 18 values with «نشان زد» against 4 with «نشان لگ» — so the clause moved to the minority form. Judged a NIT rather than a defect: both are established shipped phrasing, meaning and state are identical to a reader, and the shorter clause is exactly what UR-C2 asked for, so the alignment belongs on the description when it is next touched, not on a new round now.
